svg.title: Figure 2-5: SF-11 at the station: a person crosses the workspace ring and the arm stops; the ring as reach plus walk
svg.desc: Six boxes from the ring crossing through the station device, the logic, the safe-torque-off path, the arm's assumed stop and the standstill; a time axis to 0.6 s; a distance bar adding the 0.6 m reach and the 0.48 m walk to the 1.08 m boundary; a top view of the station with the base, the reach circle, the ring, the shelf and the person at the ring and at the reach radius.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure 2-5 SF-11 at the station: a person crosses the workspace ring and the arm stops; the ring as reach plus walk

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: §2 row SF-11: 100 + 50 + 20 = 170 ms against the 200 ms target, CFG-002; the arm's stopping time is unknown (WP-C-01 OI-6): drawn at 0.13 s so that t_r + t_b = 0.3 s, the middle case of §4.5; K = 1.6 m/s.

svg.text: Reach 0.6 m: shoulder to fingertip, read from the OpenArm 2.0 description package's joint offsets (assurance/sim/blender), not measured. Walk 0.48 m = 1.6 × (0.17 + 0.13).

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Other stopping times: 0.32 m at 0.2 s, 0.80 m at 0.5 s. The boundary is provisional (AOU-10) until upstream publishes the arm's reach and stopping time (WP-S-02 OI-8); a 0.5 s stop moves it to 1.40 m.

svg.text: Drawn to WP-S-04 v0.2 planning values (t_r 0.17 s, arm stop 0.13 s assumed, reach 0.6 m read from a description file). A loop diagram shows the arithmetic of a stop; it does not show that a measure works.
